Each offline fixture is reduced from a Bambu Studio 2.09 slice from the farm. The five Metadata XML and JSON files retain the plate settings and tool assignments. Identifying object and file names have been replaced. The G-code retains the opening header and configuration blocks and every T, M620 and M621 command in original order, including subcommands and end sentinels. Each MD5 covers the shortened G-code. Geometry, images, movement, extrusion and all other archive members were omitted.

The nine-tool CLI slice uses five of eight configured filaments. The Studio-sent slice has filament groups 8, 6, 1, 3 and 4 in file order. The two-, five- and single-filament CLI slices have group orders 1/0, 4/3/2/1/0 and 0 respectively. The captured command uses a neutral filename and a placeholder checksum.
